summary: A Yorkville spa dentistry clinic appears to lose bookings to dead menu items, mixed booking messages and unnamed proof.

findings.problem: The About and Oral Surgery menu items appear to link to #, and one Learn More card appears to link to the wrong service page.
findings.cost: Patients exploring the clinic or treatments hit dead ends.
findings.fix: Working pages behind every menu item.

findings.problem: The header pushes Book Online while the FAQ appears to say to call to book, and the contact form appears to have no appointment type or preferred time.
findings.cost: Mixed messages and a thin form lose ready patients.
findings.fix: One clear booking path and a complete form.

findings.problem: The brand appears as Eleven Dental, 11 Dental and 11 Dentistry, and typos such as Stop going to the dentist come to Eleven appear.
findings.cost: Mixed names and typos weaken trust.
findings.fix: One brand name and proofread copy.

findings.problem: Seven reviews appear with no total rating, doctors appear named only in reviews, and most images appear to be blank placeholders.
findings.cost: Patients want to see who treats them and see real photos.
findings.fix: Named dentists, a rating summary and real images.
